shared_elements: vertical grouping of signs or figures
justification: The main correspondence is that both surfaces include schematic carved imagery with curving motifs and possible anthropomorphic or creature-like elements arranged on a vertical field. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a single frontal, highly symmetrical figure with face/body features, while B appears to show an irregular, asymmetrical relief scene or cluster of profile figures/signs rather than the same iconographic scheme.
